consequence.statement: New metrics are available for monitoring; existing configurations continue to work unchanged.

original.statement: Additional kubectl metrics are now available in Argo CD.

decision.reason: [ev-674eb37b128f] lists this only as a Features entry that adds kubectl metrics. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, or must be migrated, so a review or action kind is not supported. For an addition like this, "none" (informational) is the most fitting consequence. Confidence is low because the evidence never says outright that existing setups keep working unchanged.
